void-combobox.intro: Pattern: [combobox with listbox popup](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/) (editable, list autocomplete, manual selection). The native `<input>` is the `combobox` and keeps DOM focus; the highlighted option is exposed with `aria-activedescendant`. `aria-expanded` and `open` track the list.

rows.action: Opens the list, or highlights the next option (wraps). Opening starts on the chosen option, else the first
Opens the list on the chosen option, else the last, or highlights the previous option (wraps)
Opens the list without highlighting an option
Closes the list; focus stays in the field
Chooses the highlighted option and closes the list. With no option highlighted the list closes and the key is left alone, so a surrounding form submits
Closes the list (a second Escape reaches an enclosing dialog)

rows.keys: Left Arrow, Right Arrow, Home, End
rows.action: Move the text cursor; the highlight leaves the list
Closes the list and moves on without choosing
Filter the options; nothing is highlighted until you arrow to it

void-multiselect.intro: Pattern: [select-only combobox](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/examples/combobox-select-only/) with a [multiselectable listbox](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/listbox/) popup. The trigger is the `combobox` (focusable, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded`); the list is `aria-multiselectable` and the list stays open while options are toggled. The remove buttons on the selected pills are for the pointer; from the keyboard, toggle the option in the list.

rows.action: Open the list, highlighting the first selected option, else the first
Open the list on the first option
Open the list on the last option
Open the list on the next option that starts with the typed text
Highlight the next or previous option; stops at the ends
Move the highlight ten options
Highlight the first or last option
Toggle the highlighted option; the list stays open
Jump to the next option that starts with the typed text
Close the list (a second Escape reaches an enclosing dialog)
Closes the list and moves on

void-tabs.intro: Pattern: [tabs with manual activation](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/examples/tabs-manual/) (default) or [automatic activation](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/examples/tabs-automatic/) with `activation="auto"`. The tab list is one tab stop (roving tabindex): the selected tab, or the first enabled tab while none is selected. Each tab controls its panel and each panel is labelled by its tab; the visible panel is itself a tab stop. Mark a `<void-tabs-trigger disabled>` to disable its tab.

rows.action: Enters the tab list on its tab stop, then moves to the visible panel
Move focus to the next or previous tab (wraps). With `activation="auto"` the tab is selected too. In right-to-left pages the keys swap: Left Arrow is next
Move focus to the first or last tab (selects it with `activation="auto"`)
Select the focused tab (manual activation)

void-segmented-control.intro: Pattern: [radio group](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/radio/). `role="radiogroup"` with `role="radio"` items and `aria-checked` from the first paint. One tab stop: the checked item, or the first enabled item while none is checked. Selection follows focus, so each arrow key fires `void-change`.

rows.action: Move into and out of the group
Select the next item (wraps). With nothing selected, the first
Select the previous item (wraps). With nothing selected, the last. In right-to-left pages Left Arrow selects the next item and Right Arrow the previous (Up Arrow and Down Arrow do not swap)
Selects the focused item

void-menu.intro: Pattern: [menu](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu/). The `<void-menu-content>` of `<void-menu>` is the `menu` and its items are `menuitem`s (groups are `group`s). The items are one tab stop, and the tab stop follows focus. Keys are handled on the menu, so arrow keys keep working in every other control on the page.

rows.action: Move focus to the next or previous item (wraps). From a search field, Down Arrow goes to the first item and Up Arrow to the last

rows.keys: Up Arrow on the first item
rows.action: With a `<void-menu-search>`, returns to the search field
Move focus to the first or last item
Jump to the next item that starts with the typed text (not in a `<void-menu-search>`, where typing filters)
Activate the item (`void-select`)
Closes the menu

void-dropdown-menu.intro: Pattern: [menu button](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu-button/). The trigger gets `aria-haspopup="menu"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; the panel is a `menu` labelled by the trigger, shown in the top layer. A press outside it also closes it. Items take focus from the keyboard handling, not from Tab.

rows.action: Open the menu and focus the first item (a second press closes it). A `<void-button>` or any other non-native trigger is supported
Open the menu and focus the first item
Open the menu and focus the last item
Move to the next or previous item (wraps, skips disabled items)
Move to the first or last item
Jump to the next item that starts with the typed text
Activate the item (`void-select`), close the menu and return focus to the trigger. An item with `keep-open` fires `void-select` and leaves the menu open
Closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger
Closes the menu and moves focus on to the next element; focus does not return to the trigger

void-calendar.intro: The focused day moves with the arrow keys and the selection follows Enter or Space.

rows.action: Moves focus to the previous or next day. In right-to-left pages Left Arrow is the next day and Right Arrow the previous (Up Arrow and Down Arrow do not swap)
Moves focus to the same weekday in the previous or next week
Moves focus to the first or last day of the week (the week starts on `first-day`)
Moves focus to the same day in the previous or next month

rows.keys: Shift + Page Up / Shift + Page Down
rows.action: Moves focus to the previous or next year
Chooses the focused day
Increases the value by `step` (by 1 when `step="any"`)
Decreases the value by `step` (by 1 when `step="any"`)

void-pin-input.intro: Each digit has its own cell; focus moves between cells as you type.

rows.action: Clears the cell; in an empty cell, moves to the previous cell and clears it
Clears the cell
Moves to the previous or next cell. In right-to-left pages Left Arrow is the next cell
Adds the typed text as a tag
In an empty field, removes the last tag
Previous or next slide (horizontal carousels). In right-to-left pages Left Arrow is the next slide
Previous or next slide (vertical carousels)
On a focused previous or next arrow, goes to that slide

void-nav-menu.intro: Pattern: [menubar](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menubar/). Each entry is a button or a link; hovering opens its panel too.

rows.action: Moves focus to the next or previous entry, wrapping at the ends (Down Arrow / Up Arrow in a vertical menu). In right-to-left pages the horizontal keys swap
On a button entry, opens or closes its panel; on a link, follows it
Closes the open panel and returns focus to its entry

void-toggle-group.intro: Arrow keys move focus between the toggles; they do not press them.

rows.action: Moves focus to the next or previous toggle, wrapping at the ends (horizontal). In right-to-left pages the horizontal keys swap
Moves focus to the next or previous toggle, wrapping at the ends (vertical)
Presses the focused toggle
Turns the switch on or off

void-collapsible.intro: The trigger is a button (`role="button"`, a tab stop).

rows.action: Opens or closes the section

void-dialog.intro: A modal: a native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`. The page behind it is inert, so Tab and assistive technology cannot leave it, and scrolling is locked.

rows.action: Move between the focusable elements inside the dialog, then on to the browser's own interface and back in; the page behind it cannot be reached

Closes the dialog (`void-close` with `reason` `escape`) and returns focus to the element that opened it, unless `hide-close` or a listener calls `preventDefault()` on `void-close`. With another overlay open inside it, only that overlay closes
Closes the dialog and returns focus to the opener

void-drawer.intro: A modal like the dialog: a native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`, with the page behind it inert.

rows.action: Move between the focusable elements inside the drawer, then on to the browser's own interface and back in; the page behind it cannot be reached
Closes the drawer (`void-close` with `reason` `escape`) and returns focus to the element that opened it, unless `hide-close` or a listener calls `preventDefault()` on `void-close`
Closes the drawer and returns focus to the opener

void-popover.intro: A non-modal dialog in the top layer. The trigger gets `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Focus is not trapped.

rows.action: Toggle the popover (with `trigger="click"`); opening it moves focus to its first focusable element
Move through the popover's content; moving focus out of the popover closes it
Closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger

void-hover-card.intro: Supplementary: it opens on hover or keyboard focus of the trigger and never takes focus itself.

rows.action: Opens the card at once, without the `open-delay`
Reach links and controls inside the open card; the card closes after `close-delay` once focus has left both trigger and card
Closes the card; focus stays on the trigger and does not reopen it

void-tooltip.intro: Pattern: [tooltip](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tooltip/). The trigger is described by the bubble with `aria-describedby`; the bubble never takes focus.

rows.action: Shows the tooltip at once, without the `delay` (keyboard focus only, not a click)
Hides the tooltip
Hides the tooltip without moving focus

void-date-picker.intro: The read-only input is the `combobox` and the calendar opens as a non-modal `dialog` in the top layer. Focus moves to the calendar's selected (or current) day when it opens.

rows.action: Open or close the calendar; opening focuses the selected day, else today

rows.keys: Arrow keys, Home, End, Page Up, Page Down (in the calendar)
rows.action: Move between days, as in [Calendar](#calendar)
Choose the day, close the calendar and return focus to the input
Closes the calendar and returns focus to the input
Moving focus out of the calendar closes it
